_comment: What the shop stocks, in the order viewers see it. OWNED BY THE ADMIN PANEL (Shop tab): it writes this file, so a hand edit is overwritten by the next save. It began as the four cheapest items per slot from scripts/generate-gear-content.py, a testing default; the streamer curates it now. gearPrices / consumablePrices override the SHELF price only - an item otherwise sells at its value (consumables: their own price) - and recycling still pays from the item's value. NOTE: never stock a grantGold consumable whose payout exceeds its price; that is an infinite-gold loop.
